## Runs 6–7 — both-side SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), raw before frequency read

Both runs are complete (measure cells 40 and 42; file_ids 6 and 7) at D ≈ 0 on the calibrated region-A line. Run 6 covers nominal n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻², 0→10 T at 10 mT above 1 T; run 7 covers n = −1.2×10¹² cm⁻², 10→0.3 T at 20 mT. The run-5 CNP slope fixes the gate-capacitance ratio; absolute density still carries the geometry prior. The raw TSV values and gate currents are plotted first, followed by the `hera.analysis` onset and FFT window check.

**Read for fan design.** Run 6 has a reproducible high-field feature near 29–30 T against F_L = 33.1 T nominal; a 0.8–1.2 global density rescale or the second CNP ridge (region B offset ≈ −0.43×10¹²) could move that comparison. Lower frequencies around 5–15 T change substantially with the B-window and include background/harmonic flags; they are not a counted pocket yet. The onset helper's 0.30 T headline is carried by a censored 7.1 T low-frequency track, while its 29.5 T track starts ≈1.9 T; this discrepancy is why the fan will keep the low-B record and report extraction stability rather than assume a sharp onset. Run 7 has strong low-density oscillations but its usable n range ends near −1.27×10¹² at the TG limit; the ABAB near-CNP hole pair is close and ABCA is LK heavy, so that side is not a clean template separator. **Next:** one D = 0 electron fan, n = +2.2…+3.2×10¹², to measure F(n) and test the Luttinger sum, harmonic tracks, and region-A/B ambiguity.

"""Raw then SdH spot-check read, runs 6 and 7 (session data only)."""
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, summarize_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, resolve_channels
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

_candidates = [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents]
_data_dir = next((p / "data" for p in _candidates if (p / "data" / "6" / "metadata.json").is_file()), None)
if _data_dir is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError("session data/6 absent below ana kernel cwd")

for rid, n_nom in ((6, 3.2), (7, -1.2)):
    r = open_run(_data_dir / str(rid))
    print(summarize_run(r))
    ch = {x.cid: x for x in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    I_bias = (r.meta["instruments"]["sr1"]["snapshot"]["parameters"]["amplitude"]["value"] /
              r.meta["measurement_config"]["bias_resistor"])
    R = r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain / I_bias
    I_drain = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    T = r.col("T_sample")
    itg, ibg = r.col("k_2400_tg_curr"), r.col("k_2400_bg_curr")
    print(f"run {rid}: I_bias={I_bias*1e9:.2f} nA; Rxx {R.min():.1f}..{R.max():.1f} Ohm; "
          f"drain {I_drain.min()*1e9:.2f}..{I_drain.max()*1e9:.2f} nA; "
          f"T {T.min():.3f}..{T.max():.3f} K; "
          f"I_tg {itg.min()*1e12:.0f}..{itg.max()*1e12:.0f} pA; "
          f"I_bg {ibg.min()*1e12:.0f}..{ibg.max()*1e12:.0f} pA")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(8, 5), sharex=True)
    ax[0].plot(B, R, lw=.8); ax[0].set_ylabel("raw Rxx (Ohm)")
    ax[1].plot(B, itg*1e12, lw=.6, label="TG")
    ax[1].plot(B, ibg*1e12, lw=.6, label="BG")
    ax[1].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="gate current (pA)"); ax[1].legend()
    fig.suptitle(f"run {rid}: raw B_1–B_2 and gate currents, n={n_nom:+.1f}e12, D=0")
    fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6/I_bias)
    print(on.summary())
    print("The lowest-frequency tracks may include detrending residuals; test by B-window stability.")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.5))
    for cutoff in ((1.5, 2.0, 2.5) if rid == 6 else (1.0, 2.0, 3.0)):
        f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cutoff, 10.0), nfft=2048, log=False)
        y = spec[0]
        pk, _ = find_peaks(y, prominence=.02*y.max(), distance=8)
        pk = sorted(pk, key=lambda p: y[p], reverse=True)[:5]
        print(f"run {rid} FFT B={cutoff:g}..10 T: " +
              ", ".join(f"{f[p]:.1f} T" for p in pk))
        ax.plot(f, y, label=f"B>{cutoff:g} T")
    ax.set(xlim=(0, 75), xlabel="frequency (T)", ylabel="FFT amplitude",
           title=f"run {rid}: B-window stability, B-space detrend first")
    ax.legend(); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: D = 0 electron Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`) for region-resolved FS count

> **05:25** · D=0 electron fan: n +3.2 to +2.2e12 cm^-2 (46 paired TG/BG points), B 0.70 to 10.0 T (134 uniform 1/B rows), Si 0 V, sr1 50 uV, 2.4 s fast dwell · **ETA ~11:55** (≈6h30m)

Runs 6–7 (ana cells 14–15) favor the electron side: run 6 has a reproducible ≈29–30 T high-field feature at nominal n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻², while run 7 is confined to the low-density hole-side exception regime. The 29–30 T feature alone does not settle ABAB vs ABCA: F_L is 33.1 T at nominal n, the region-B CNP is offset by ≈−0.43×10¹², and the low-frequency tracks change with the B-window. This fan tests F(n), the Luttinger sum, and harmonics on the provided B_1–B_2 channel; a mixed-domain contribution remains possible.

**Design and coverage.** Use the run-5 region-A calibration (ratio c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 from the CNP slope, absolute scale from geometry) at D = 0, n = +2.2…+3.2×10¹² cm⁻²; TG +0.697…+0.984 V, BG +0.795…+1.166 V, Si 0 V. The hole side and n < +2.2 are excluded: the former is TG-limited and near the model's close-tone regime; the latter makes the ABAB light pocket too slow for a five-period window and raises the high-B resistance. This is a per-column SdH FFT fan, **134 field rows** uniform in 1/B from **0.70→10.0 T**, **46 density points** descending on each row, 6,164 points total. At n_max = 3.2, F_L = 33.09 T and Δ(1/B) = 0.00999 T⁻¹ ≤ 1/(3F_L) = 0.01007; at B_lo = 0.70 T the fourfold ray spacing is 0.0677×10¹² cm⁻² and Δn = 0.0222 gives 3.05 points/ray. The model's light ABAB pocket at n_min = 2.2 is 4.16 T: the 1/B window yields 5.53 periods, δF = 0.75 T, and the heavy-vs-singleton split there is 4.17 T > 2δF. This low-field reach preserves the uncertain light-tone/onset evidence instead of treating the helper's censored 0.30 T low-frequency headline as a measured onset.

**Preflight and price.** The cell asserts fresh sample/vaporizer thermometry, base T, field ≈0, gates and Si ≈0, persistent-switch heater/output on, the committed caps, 1 V drive, and 0.3 s/24 dB lock-in settling. Sensitivity 50 µV gives 5 kΩ full scale at 10 nA; runs 6–7 reached ≤576 Ω, and this electron window stays ≥+2.2, with a live 85%-FS trip. At 2.4 s fast delay (8τ), run 5's measured ~0.17 s/point overhead, ~68 min bare 0.7→10 T traverse plus ~5 min positioning, and ~9 min row settles, the realistic total is **≈6 h 30 m** including ~10% margin. The magnet ends at 10 T and gates at n = +2.2 for the next read; no unmeasured return traverse is hidden in this price. **Checkpoints:** after the first two B rows inspect all live channels, gate-current/rail trips and row geometry; at ~2 T, ~4 T, ~7 T inspect landed-row digests and partial raw/FFT structure, continuing only if signal and thermometry remain credible. At completion, re-form the raw native-grid map before any classification.

# === Electron D=0 Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`), region-A calibration from run 5 ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Preconditions: state inherited from operator handoff, not set by this cell.
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live("T_vaporizer", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_vaporizer"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _Tv0, _B0 = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_Vtg0, _Vbg0, _Vsi0 = k_tg.volt(), k_bg.volt(), k_si()
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
_amp, _tau, _slope = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"precondition: T_sample={_T0:.3f} K (1.0..1.5), T_vaporizer={_Tv0:.3f} K (0.7..1.5); "
      f"B={_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05); TG={_Vtg0:+.4f}, BG={_Vbg0:+.4f}, Si={_Vsi0:+.4f} V (all 0); "
      f"PS_on={_ps}, output={_out}; drive={_amp:.3f} V (1), sr1 tau={_tau:.3f} s (0.3), slope={_slope} dB/oct (24)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and 0.7 <= _Tv0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05
assert abs(_Vtg0) < 0.01 and abs(_Vbg0) < 0.01 and abs(_Vsi0) < 0.01
assert _ps and _out and abs(_amp - 1.0) < 0.01 and abs(_tau - 0.3) < 0.001 and _slope == 24
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0
assert (TG_MIN, TG_MAX, BG_MIN, BG_MAX, SI_MIN, SI_MAX) == (-0.3, 1.0, -1.3, 2.0, -25.0, 25.0)
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-3, c_bg=2.161e-3, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
ns = np.linspace(3.2, 2.2, 46)                         # 1e12 cm^-2, high n first
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)                                  # V/nm, calibrated physical D=0
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, **CAL)
n_check, D_check = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, **CAL)
assert np.allclose(n_check, ns, atol=1e-10) and np.max(np.abs(D_check)) < 1e-10
assert min(Vtgs) >= TG_MIN and max(Vtgs) <= TG_MAX and min(Vbgs) >= BG_MIN and max(Vbgs) <= BG_MAX
B_vec = 1 / np.linspace(1/0.70, 1/10.0, 134)           # uniform in 1/B; 0.70 -> 10 T
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec[-1] <= B_SESSION_CAP
F_L_max = 33.09
ray_at_Blo = 0.09672 * B_vec[0]                         # 1e12 cm^-2 for g=4
dinvB = abs(1/B_vec[1] - 1/B_vec[0])
dn = abs(ns[1] - ns[0])
assert dinvB <= 1/(3*F_L_max) and dn <= ray_at_Blo/3
print(f"fan: B {B_vec[0]:.2f}->{B_vec[-1]:.2f} T, {len(B_vec)} rows, d(1/B)={dinvB:.5f} T^-1; "
      f"n {ns[0]:+.2f}->{ns[-1]:+.2f}e12, {len(ns)} points/row, dn={dn:.4f}e12; "
      f"TG {Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f}, BG {Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V")

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.4, 1.0                 # 8 tau at 24 dB/oct; slow row dwell after blocking B set
I_TRIP, V_RAIL = 1e-9, 0.85 * 50e-6
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)                            # 5 kOhm FS at 1 V / 100 MOhm = 10 nA
print(f"sr1 sensitivity={sr1.sensitivity():.2e} V, full-scale R={sr1.sensitivity()/(_amp/100e6):.0f} Ohm; "
      f"fast delay={FAST_DELAY:.1f} s = {FAST_DELAY/_tau:.1f} tau")

# One 5-min bare position from the verified 0 T handoff; driver blocks through settle.
magnet.field(float(B_vec[0]))
s = sweep.AsyncStation(dict(meas_config,
    **{"Si (V)": _Vsi0, "sample_temperature:": _T0,
       "comments": "landau-fan-vti electron: region-A run-5 calibration; D=0 V/nm, n=+3.2..+2.2e12 cm^-2 (46), B=0.70..10.0 T (134 uniform 1/B), TG/BG paired, Si=0, sr1 50uV, fast_delay=2.4s"}))
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment('electron D=0; n +3.2 to +2.2e12 cm^-2, 46 pts; B 0.70 to 10.0 T, 134 rows uniform 1/B; run-5 cal ratio 0.773, n_offset -0.0894e12, D_offset -0.013 V/nm; Si 0 V; sr1 50 uV, fast delay 2.4 s')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbgs[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtgs[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)

# multimegasweep row: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, I_tg, I_bg, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, v_rxx = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), abs(float(data[9]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP or v_rxx > V_RAIL:
        print(f"FAN TRIP B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, TG={float(data[2]):+.4f} V: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e} A, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A, |sr1.X|={v_rxx:.3e} V")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                 slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
print(f"fan ended: B={magnet.field():+.3f} T, TG={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, BG={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V; "
      "field and gates held for disk-first analysis")
